reason: Both replies rightly keep the A1C promise off the page and ask for the dietitian's name, real menu items and cancellation terms. B goes a bit further for this wary reader: it pushes a plain medication disclosure, an explanation of why consistent carbs matter, and a check on contract and trial terms, while A spends advice on caregivers and customer quotes. B does assert without support that the 0.6 average covers all 14, which A handles more carefully.
